commits.message:
chore(deps)!: move every dependency to its latest release (0.10.0) (#129)

Peer floors rise to mobx ^7.0.3 and @promptctl/go-template-js ^0.9.0.

- mobx 7 drops observable.ref/.shallow for named observableRef and
  observableShallow, and makeObservable now requires annotations; every
  class uses TC39 accessor decorators, which register themselves, so the
  three makeObservable(this) calls are gone.
- TypeScript 7 ships no JavaScript compiler API, which the seam and
  coverage gates are built on, so typescript stays on 6.0.3, the newest
  release that has one. Its empty default for `types` is restored to
  ["node"] in tsconfig.json.
- Vite 8 compiles TypeScript with oxc, which passes TC39 decorators
  through to Node verbatim. vitest now compiles project .ts files with
  tsc and tsconfig.json, the compiler that builds dist/.
